rejection.details:
Your petition calling for the death penalty (in certain circumstances) is the same as the request made in a number of petitions we already have open which call for capital punishment in this context or in another.

You may want to look at these petitions (links below) and sign ones with which you are in agreement:

https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions?state=open&q=capital+punishment

https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions?state=open&q=death+penalty
